meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾：自动读取交接文件，确认消息通道正常，把账号设为所有者，迁移旧记忆，核对容器配置，并帮你处理 v1 定制代码的移植。
howto.when: 在你提到“migrate from v1”、“finish migration”等，且 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 已成功执行、交接文件存在时触发；若交接文件缺失，会先要求你运行该脚本。

say.text: 帮我完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾。
say.note: 开始读取 handoff 并分阶段处理。

say.text: 迁移完成后，把 owner 权限给我。
say.note: 确认身份后授予 owner 角色。

say.text: 我的 v1 定制代码该怎么处理？

howto.what_en: Finishes NanoClaw v1→v2 migration: reads the handoff file, checks message routing, seeds the owner role, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port v1 fork customizations.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", etc., after `bash migrate-v2.sh` finishes and handoff.json exists; otherwise tells you to run the script first.
